changelog:
- Direct Browser Launch: App icon opens Fokk Super-Browser directly with instant tab resume.
- Decentralized Privacy Account & Cyberpunk Badges: Local vault profile with custom avatar photos and 6 cyberpunk insignias (Falcon, Aegis, Terminal, Vault, Valkyrie, Spectre).
- 1-Click AdGuard DNS Engine: In-app real-time DoH domain filtering dropping ad networks before network handshakes with zero VPN and zero Accessibility overhead.
- Mobile Private DNS Hub: Quick configuration for AdGuard, Mullvad, Cloudflare, and Control D system-wide DNS.
- Financial Apps Zero-Disruption Whitelist: Essential payment portals (PayPal, Stripe, Visa, Mastercard, Google Pay, NPCI) protected against false positives.
